title: Welcome Playbook: first-launch cards, snackbar tips, and empty-state illustration suite
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a complete visual and asset pack for the console first-run experience that includes: 1) a modular set of welcome/first-launch cards for the dashboard and project-level views, 2) snackbar/inline tip variants for progressive disclosure (short, medium, long copy with CTA/button, dismiss behavior), 3) a family of empty-state illustrations and composable layouts for common console surfaces, 4) responsive screenshot mockups (desktop/tablet/mobile) and annotated specs for implementation, 5) accessible color token contrast checks and copy length constraints for localization.
comments: 2025-01-20 - PM review: Added request to support two CTA variants (primary + tertiary) on welcome cards for self-serve flows.
2025-01-22 - Accessibility review (Nia M.): Contrast pass except 'muted-subtle' caption token on small text; updated token suggestions included in Figma.

2025-01-24 - Engineering feasibility (Rui K.): Snackbar animation timing needs to be 200ms shorter on low-end devices; added motion-reduced variants. Raised ENG-7801 as follow-up for runtime behavior.
2025-01-28 - Design critique (team): Chose 'stacked card' layout over 'carousel' for lists with >3 items to avoid hidden discoverability. Added alt-layouts for large orgs.
